subscription.title: Premium
subscription.restore_none_body: We couldn't find an active subscription for this store account. Make sure you're signed in with the Apple ID or Google account you subscribed with.
subscription.legal_disclaimer: Payment is charged to your store account at confirmation. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it anytime in your store account settings.
subscription.offerings_error_body: Check your connection and try again.
subscription.manage_unavailable_ios: Open the Settings app, tap your name, then Subscriptions.
subscription.manage_unavailable_android: Open the Play Store app, tap your profile, then Payments & subscriptions.
subscription.notice_duplicate: We found more than one active subscription on your account. Please contact support so we can sort out the billing.
subscription.notice_grace: There's a problem with your payment method. Update it to keep your Premium access.
subscription.notice_grace_dated: There's a problem with your payment method. Update it before {{date}} to keep your Premium access.
subscription.notice_on_hold: Your subscription is on hold because of a payment problem. Update your payment method to restore Premium — you don't need to buy it again.
subscription.notice_paused_dated: Your subscription is paused and resumes on {{date}}.
subscription.notice_family_shared: Premium is shared with you through Family Sharing. It's managed by the family member who bought it.
subscription.notice_promotional_dated: You have complimentary Premium access until {{date}}.
subscription.notice_cross_store: Your subscription was purchased through a different store. Tap below to manage it.
subscription.notice_pending_change: Your plan change is scheduled. You keep your current plan until it takes effect.
subscription.notice_pending_change_dated: Your plan change takes effect on {{date}}. You keep your current plan until then.
subscription.notice_cancelled: Your subscription is cancelled. You still have Premium access, and you can resubscribe any time.
subscription.notice_cancelled_dated: Your subscription is cancelled. You have Premium access until {{date}}, and you can resubscribe any time.
subscription.notice_trial_dated: Your free trial ends on {{date}}, when your subscription begins.
subscription.notice_active: You have an active Premium subscription.
subscription.cross_platform_body: Your subscription was purchased on {{store}}. You can upgrade, downgrade or cancel it only there.
subscription.cross_platform_body_generic: Your subscription was purchased on a different platform. You can upgrade, downgrade or cancel it only there.
subscription.gate_default_body: This feature is part of Premium. Subscribe to get access to everything.
subscription.plan_change_deferred: Your plan will change when your current subscription period ends.
subscription.plan_change_next_billing: Your plan has been changed. The new price starts from your next billing date.
subscription.plan_change_blocked_body: Your subscription was bought with a different {{account}}, so it can't be changed from this device. Sign in to {{store}} with the {{account}} you used to subscribe, then change your plan there.
subscription.wrong_store_body: Your subscription was purchased on a different store. Please manage it from the store you bought it in.
subscription.linked_body: This Apple ID or Google account already has a subscription linked to a different profile. Sign in with that profile to use it.
subscription.error_pending: Your purchase is being processed — Premium unlocks as soon as it clears.
subscription.error_store_unreachable: Couldn't reach {{store}}. Check your connection and try again.
subscription.error_not_allowed: Purchases are turned off on this device. Check your device restrictions.
subscription.error_not_available: This plan isn't available in your region yet.
subscription.error_ineligible: This offer isn't available on your account.
